note: One table for the scale of the ping colors: the quality of a round trip in milliseconds (good under 80, fair under 150, poor from there, none for no number). tests/test_net/test_latency.cpp runs it through ping_quality() of include/ants_net/latency.hpp and tests/scripts/web_lobby_rules_check.js through pingQuality() of web/front/lobby_rules.js, so the two cannot drift apart. A case is one line: ms (the number, -1 for none) and quality (none, good, fair, poor).
